title: Google contextual advertising in Spain: order setup

facts.fact: Spain has a population of nearly 50 million, according to the vendor's page.
facts.quote: Spain has a population of nearly 50 million, a high rate of online shopping, and an audience accustomed to searching for products and services online.

facts.fact: According to various estimates cited by the vendor, the average CPC in Spain is roughly half that of the U.S.
facts.quote: according to various estimates, the average CPC is roughly half that of the U.S.

facts.fact: The vendor states that for most European niches the cost per click hovers around a couple of euros, and in less competitive niches it drops to €1.
facts.quote: For most European niches, the cost per click hovers around a couple of euros, and in less competitive niches, it drops to €1.

facts.fact: In Spain, the official sales periods (Rebajas) occur in January and July, according to the vendor.
facts.quote: The Rebajas (official sales) in January and July reshape retail demand.

facts.fact: Google Shopping is described by the vendor as practically a must-have for online stores in Spain.
facts.quote: For online stores, this is practically a must-have.

facts.fact: The vendor's setup process for Spain includes five stages: business and website analysis, semantic research, creating ads, technical setup, and launching and optimizing campaigns.
facts.quote: The turnkey setup of contextual advertising in Spain is carried out in several stages:

facts.fact: The vendor notes that weight-loss product advertising is heavily regulated in Spain under Google's advertising policies, alongside specific rules for healthcare, finance, and alcohol.
facts.quote: advertising weight-loss products is heavily regulated here, and there are specific rules regarding healthcare, finance, and alcohol.

facts.fact: The vendor describes Valencia as a growing market where competition is less intense and cost per click is usually lower than in Madrid.
facts.quote: Valencia is a growing market; competition is less intense, and the cost per click is usually lower than in Madrid.

facts.fact: The vendor describes Madrid as the largest and most competitive market with high purchasing power but an expensive auction.
facts.quote: Madrid is the largest and most competitive market—a capital city with high purchasing power, but also an expensive auction;

facts.fact: The vendor says Performance Max should be launched only once an advertiser has analytics history and high-quality conversion data.
facts.quote: It works well when you already have a history of analytics and high-quality conversion data.

facts.fact: The vendor states the first few weeks of a campaign are for gathering data and fine-tuning.
facts.quote: The first few weeks are all about gathering data and fine-tuning.

facts.fact: A minimum media budget of €300–500 per month can be used to test a narrow niche with Google contextual advertising in Spain, according to the vendor.
facts.quote: With a minimum media budget of €300–500 per month, you can test a narrow niche, but for most projects, a realistic starting point is €500–1,000 or more

facts.fact: The vendor states that for most projects a realistic starting media budget for contextual advertising in Spain is €500–1,000 or more per month.
facts.quote: for most projects, a realistic starting point is €500–1,000 or more, depending on the region and objectives.

facts.fact: According to the vendor, in highly competitive niches such as law, dentistry, and real estate in Spain a Google click can cost several euros or more, while in less competitive niches a click may cost less than one euro.
facts.quote: In less competitive niches, a click might cost less than a euro; in highly competitive ones (such as law, dentistry, and real estate), it can cost several euros or more.

facts.fact: The vendor says the launch of contextual advertising usually takes a few days, and it typically takes about the first month to achieve consistent results.
facts.value: a few days; about one month
facts.quote: The launch itself usually takes a few days. But it takes the first month or so to achieve consistent results, while the system gathers data.

facts.fact: The vendor lists three contractor pricing models for setting up contextual advertising in Spain: one-time setup fee, monthly maintenance subscription, and a percentage of the advertising budget.
facts.quote: One-time setup from scratch — a fixed fee for setup; Monthly maintenance — a subscription fee for management and optimization; A percentage of the advertising budget

facts.fact: The vendor describes a Google Ads example in which a single Search campaign targeting Valencia and a set of ten campaigns covering all of Spain represent different scopes of work with different price points.
facts.quote: A single Search campaign targeting Valencia and a set of ten campaigns covering all of Spain represent different scopes of work—and therefore different price points.

facts.fact: The vendor gives the example that a €3 click bringing a €300 order is more profitable than a €0.5 click that produces no sale.
facts.value: €3 click / €300 order vs €0.5 click / no sale
facts.quote: A €3 click that brings in a €300 order is more profitable than a €0.5 click that doesn’t result in a single sale.
